From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Claire Barnes <claire@solacehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Oct 2028 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final MSA redlines + signing window

Sofia / Claire,

Legal Ops confirms we can support the witness requirement with two recommended options (summary below). Both preserve a single clean copy at the end and record the witness as a signer role in DocuSign.

Option A (single envelope, sequential roles) - Preferred for speed:
- Envelope contains: MSA (clean PDF) + Order Form.
- Signing order: Redwood signatory -> Solace signatory -> Solace witness.
- Witness role set as "In-person witness" in DocuSign with a signature and a text field for printed name + witness address.
- We enable signer authentication (email + access code) and set the witness step to capture IP and a signed timestamp.
- After completion DocuSign produces a combined, time-stamped PDF. We will copy the final PDF to Drive and push to HubSpot.

Option B (two-envelope approach) - If Solace prefers an in-person witnessed physical sign-off:
- Envelope 1: DocuSign tracking for initial sign (either Redwood or Solace as needed).
- Envelope 2: Witness-only step where Solace witness signs a witness attestation PDF (we prep a short witness affidavit).
- Legal Ops will merge final PDFs and notarize metadata in the audit trail. This takes 24 hours to produce final clean copy.

Request from Solace: if you choose Option A, provide the witness name and email by Tue 18:00 PT so we can seed the envelope. If you choose Option B, confirm whether you will courier a wet-signed original or send a scanned affidavit post-signing.

We will set the DocuSign envelope to auto-complete and send the final combined PDF to: Drive folder (MSA_CleanCopies) and HubSpot deal record. ETA for final clean copy: Option A = within 30 minutes of last signature; Option B = within 24 hours (merge + QA).

Attachments: witness_affidavit_template.pdf (1pg)

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Legal Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
